    From a split point of the ray category to the algebra (bridge) #

    A SplitAt V₁ Z point of the ray category of a split basic distributive algebra B gives a SplitPoint of B (with e₁ the sum of the idempotents of V₁, e_z, and e₂ the rest), so a minimal representation-infinite B has no split point (SplitPoint.not_minimal). With RaySmall this gives NoSplit for the small ray category.
